inference_methods.name: laplace
inference_methods.short_doc: Laplace approximation around the MAP (cold ~5-9s, warm ~1-2s, ~3 GB)

inference_methods.name: mcmc
inference_methods.short_doc: Auto MCMC: NUTS for low-D, raytrace for high-D

inference_methods.name: mcmc_hmc
inference_methods.short_doc: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (cold ~21s, ~5 GB on D=6-7). Convergence-validated only with dense_mass_matrix=True, n_warmup≥1000, n_leapfrog_steps≥20 on D=6 DPL (R-hat 1.008, ESS 411). Default n_warmup=300 / dense=True gives R-hat ≫ 1, do not lower the warmup for science.

inference_methods.name: mcmc_nuts
inference_methods.short_doc: No-U-Turn Sampler (cold ~90s at D=6 DPL; warmup blows past 5 min on dense_basis D=7, prefer mcmc_hmc or mcmc_ghmc for dense_basis SFH)

inference_methods.name: vi
inference_methods.short_doc: NIFTy geoVI variational inference (cold ~100s, ~20 GB RSS at D=6-7, memory-heavy; consider mcmc_hmc for faster turnaround on D<10)

inference_methods.name: hmc_is
inference_methods.short_doc: HMC posterior + importance-sampled log-evidence (cold ~30s at D=6; check diagnostics['ess'] and diagnostics['max_weight_frac'] for quality)

inference_methods.name: mcmc_adjusted_mclmc
inference_methods.short_doc: Adjusted microcanonical Langevin (cold ~60s, ~3x compile premium over mclmc). Requires blackjax >= 1.6.

inference_methods.name: mcmc_dynamic_hmc
inference_methods.short_doc: Dynamic HMC, fast (cold ~19s) but chains under-mix at default settings (R-hat ≈ 1.11-1.25, ESS ≈ 1-30 on D=6-7 mocks, 1000 warmup + 2000 samples). Needs tuning before science use.

inference_methods.name: mcmc_ess
inference_methods.short_doc: Elliptical slice sampling, cheap (cold ~10s, ~2 GB) but assumes a Gaussian prior; bias on uniform/bounded priors not yet validated

inference_methods.name: nss
inference_methods.short_doc: Nested sampling, slow (cold ~240s at D=6, timeout >600s at D=7); use for evidence/model comparison, not point estimates
